crossRefs.note: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

parallels.note: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

translations.web: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: All the four-footed animals that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening,
translations.kjv: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And whatsoever goeth upon its paws, among all beasts that go on all fours, they are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcass shall be unclean until the even.
